**About Us**

At Travel Counsellors, our customers, communities, and colleagues are at the heart of everything we do. For over 30 years, we've empowered 2,200+ independent travel agents worldwide, helping them build successful businesses while providing deeply personal, human connections with their customers. Supported by a talented team of over 400 people in our Support Offices, we create unique travel experiences that keep customers coming back. Named the Best Place to Work in Travel (2022) and ranked in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work (2023, 2024 & 2025), we’re expanding rapidly and looking for exceptional individuals to join our Head Office team.

**About the Role**

The Data and AI Scientist will play a crucial role in turning data, experimentation and AI into measurable business value for Travel Counsellors. The role involves developing and evaluating solutions for areas such as pricing, customer behaviour and operational efficiency - starting from a clear understanding of the business problem, the customer need and the outcome that matters. Working with commercial, product, engineering and operational teams, the Data and AI Scientist will build, test and operationalise ML/AI solutions. They will translate evidence into clear business implications and recommend next steps. The role requires them to actively shape and embed responsible and effective AI-enabled ways of working, while enabling the wider data team to do the same.

**Principal Accountabilities**

  

· Build, validate and deploy predictive models for optimising pricing, personalised recommendations and operational efficiencies, connecting technical performance to customer, commercial and operational outcomes.

* Collaborate with data and software engineers to operationalise ML models within our wider technology platform and deliver on our AI ambitions, monitoring adoption, performance and realised value after launch.

* Conduct in-depth analysis of large datasets to identify trends, patterns and anomalies related to customer behaviour, booking patterns and market trends, and distinguish material business signals from statistical noise.

* Develop and present clear, actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders through excellent verbal and written communication, tailoring the narrative to the decision being made and the audience's level of technical understanding.

* Design, analyse and critically evaluate A/B tests and other experiments, including power, bias, statistical significance, practical significance and limitations; explain what the results mean in real terms for customers, revenue, cost, risk and colleague experience.

* Challenge model performance analysis and experimentation conclusions constructively, identify gaps in evidence or unintended consequences, and articulate proportionate next steps and why they are the right actions.

* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data science and AI, advocating for continuous improvement and responsible use within the team.

* Use AI tools responsibly and effectively throughout the data scientist's workflow, including problem framing, research, coding, analysis, documentation, testing and communication; validate outputs, protect sensitive information and retain appropriate human judgement.

* Lead data-related projects, ensuring timely delivery while balancing multiple priorities and stakeholder needs, and steer the wider data team to adopt useful, secure and repeatable AI-enabled ways of working.

  
  

**Required Experience**

  

• Strong understanding of business models, customer needs and value drivers, with the ability to connect analysis and model outputs to commercial, customer and operational decisions

* Expertise in developing and deploying various ML algorithms, e.g. recommendations

* Experience applying statistical methods to analyse data, test hypotheses, design and interpret A/B tests, and draw conclusions that distinguish statistical from practical significance

* Highly proficient in Python for data manipulation, analysis and model development

* Strong SQL skills for querying and manipulating data from relational databases

* Understanding of database concepts and experience with data warehousing solutions

title: Employee Relations Manager
description:
**Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants**
===============================================

**Position:** Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Industry:** IT Staffing & Professional Services  
**Location:** Remote / Hybrid

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an experienced and highly professional **Employee Relations Manager – W2 Consultants** to serve as the **primary point of contact for our W2 consultant workforce**.

This position will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle and ensuring that their questions, concerns, and requests are addressed promptly and professionally.

The ideal candidate will combine strong **employee-relations expertise, communication skills, IT staffing knowledge, and operational judgment**. This individual should be approachable and responsive while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and appropriate boundaries when handling sensitive employee matters.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Employee & Consultant Relations**

* Serve as the **primary point of contact for W2 consultants** regarding employment-related questions, concerns, and requests.
* Establish and maintain professional, trusted relationships with consultants throughout their employment lifecycle.
* Provide timely communication and appropriate follow-up on consultant inquiries and concerns.
* Listen to employee concerns, understand the underlying issue, and coordinate with the appropriate internal stakeholders to achieve resolution.
* Handle sensitive and escalated matters with discretion, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Maintain accurate records of employee concerns, communications, actions taken, and resolutions.

### **Payroll & Employment Support**

* Coordinate with Payroll and HR regarding questions related to **salary, payroll processing, timesheets, deductions, reimbursements, benefits, and employment documentation**.
* Assist consultants in understanding company processes and requirements.
* Monitor outstanding payroll or employment-related issues and ensure appropriate follow-up through resolution.
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the appropriate management or functional team.

### **Immigration Coordination**

* Serve as the communication liaison between consultants and the organization's **Immigration/Legal team**.
* Coordinate requests and documentation related to **H-1B transfers, extensions, amendments, OPT/EAD, and other employment authorization matters**.
* Ensure consultants receive timely updates regarding the status of immigration-related requests.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up without providing independent legal or immigration advice.

### **Marketing, Projects & Consultant Support**

* Coordinate with Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, and Account Management regarding consultant **marketing status, job opportunities, submissions, interviews, project assignments, and placement activities**.
* Ensure consultants receive appropriate updates regarding their project or marketing status.
* Assist consultants during onboarding, project transitions, client interviews, assignments, and offboarding.
* Identify and escalate issues that may impact consultant engagement, retention, or project continuity.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner effectively with **HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing/Bench Sales, Sales, Account Management, and senior management**.
* Take ownership of consultant issues and ensure they are routed to the appropriate department.
* Maintain visibility into open issues and proactively follow up until resolution.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and recommend improvements to policies, processes, and communication.
* Develop and maintain effective communication processes between consultants and internal departments.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field** preferred.
* **3–7+ years of experience** in Employee Relations, HR Operations, Consultant Relations, IT Staffing, Workforce Management, or a related field.
* Previous experience supporting **W2 IT consultants** within a U.S. staffing or consulting organization is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the U.S. IT staffing and consulting environment.
* Familiarity with **H-1B, H-1B transfers, OPT/EAD, and employment authorization processes**.
* Experience coordinating with Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, HR, and staffing operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive employee concerns with professionalism and discretion.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple departments.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* **Employee & Consultant Relationship Management**
* **Conflict Resolution & Issue Management**
* **Cross-Functional Coordination**
* **Professional Communication**
* **Problem Solving & Ownership**
* **Confidentiality & Professional Judgment**
* **U.S. Staffing Operations**
* **Payroll & Employment Processes**
* **Immigration Coordination**
* **Consultant Engagement & Retention**

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to provide W2 consultants with a **consistent, responsive, and professional employee experience**.

The Employee Relations Manager is expected to:

* Establish strong relationships and trust with the consultant workforce.
* Respond to consultant inquiries in a timely manner.
* Ensure issues are appropriately assigned, tracked, and resolved.
* Maintain clear and consistent communication throughout the resolution process.
* Minimize recurring consultant concerns through proactive communication and process improvement.
* Strengthen collaboration between consultants and internal departments.
* Support overall consultant engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

### **The Role in One Sentence**

**The Employee Relations Manager will serve as the central point of contact and advocate for our W2 consultants, coordinating across HR, Payroll, Immigration, Recruiting, Marketing, and Management to ensure their employment-related needs are addressed professionally and efficiently.**

WORKO helps businesses, startups and corporate organizations establish and expand their operations in Indore. * Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective clients.

* Ability to identify new business opportunities and generate leads independently.
* Comfortable with cold calling, client meetings and field visits.
* Self-motivated and target-oriented approach.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Candidates with experience in corporate client acquisition, B2B sales, commercial real estate, office leasing, facility management or business consulting will be preferred.
* Candidates with experience handling corporate clients and decision-makers will have an added advantage.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Cluster Talent Acquistion Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Recruitment Manager – AI Talent Acquisition owns end-to-end hiring for Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and adjacent emerging-technology roles (e.g., AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, MLOps/AI Infrastructure Engineers, LLM/Agentic AI Specialists, AI Architects, and Responsible AI/Governance specialists). Given the acute global shortage of AI talent, this role requires a specialist recruiter who can navigate a highly competitive, fast-moving skills market and consistently deliver quality closures against aggressive timelines.

The role partners closely with business/technical stakeholders, delivery leaders, and sourcing partners/agencies to build differentiated pipelines for niche AI skills, while managing a team of recruiters to ensure disciplined execution, accurate skill classification, and strong candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. AI Talent Strategy & Pipeline Building**

* Design and execute sourcing strategies for hard-to-find AI/ML skills (model building, RAG, agentic AI, MLOps, AI infra/platform engineering, Responsible AI/Governance) across offshore and onsite locations.
* Build and continuously nurture a proactive AI talent pipeline through LinkedIn, niche job boards, referrals, campus programs, and specialist recruitment vendors/agencies to reduce dependency on reactive hiring.
* Partner with business and technical SMEs to accurately translate emerging AI skill requirements (e.g., LLMs, NVIDIA stacks, Kubernetes, LangChain/LangGraph) into precise job descriptions and sourcing keywords.

**2. End-to-End Recruitment Delivery**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle for AI roles — requisition intake, sourcing, screening, technical panel coordination, offer management, and onboarding — against defined SLAs (e.g., 24-hour resume submission turnaround).
* Track and drive conversion metrics (TP1/TP2 panel outcomes, offer-to-join ratios) and proactively flag risks such as counter-offers, competing offers, or notice-period gaps for niche AI profiles.
* Coordinate with technical panels/architects to validate candidate fitment against nuanced AI skill boundaries (e.g., differentiating AI infra architects from application-side AI architects, or model-building versus fine-tuning expertise).

**3. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage and rationalize a portfolio of specialist AI recruitment agencies/vendors, evaluating fulfillment performance and quality of profiles submitted, and course-correcting underperforming partners.
* Act as the primary escalation point for business leaders and delivery SPOCs on AI hiring status, running regular cadences to review sourcing traction, pipeline health, and blockers.
* Provide leadership with accurate, timely reporting on demand-vs-fulfillment, skill-wise supply status, and hiring exceptions requiring approval.

**4. Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, mentor, and performance-manage a team of recruiters focused on AI/niche skill hiring, building their domain fluency in AI terminology and evaluation criteria.
* Champion compliance, data integrity, and consistent process discipline (e.g., interview feedback formats, band-mapping, documentation) across the AI hiring pipeline.

**5. Market Intelligence & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay current on the evolving AI talent landscape — in-demand skills (Python, LLMs, RAG, agentic frameworks, MLOps), compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring trends — to keep sourcing strategies sharp.

**Interpersonal Competencies**

* Stakeholder Influence: Builds credibility with technical leaders and business stakeholders to align on hard-to-fill AI requirements and manage expectations on realistic timelines.
* Technical Curiosity & Fluency: Comfortable learning and conversing in AI/ML terminology (LLMs, RAG, MLOps, agentic AI) well enough to engage credibly with both candidates and technical panels.
* Negotiation & Persuasion: Skilled at closing candidates in a highly competitive AI talent market, managing counter-offers and compensation conversations with confidence.
* Team Leadership & Coaching: Motivates and upskills a recruiting team, fostering ownership and resilience amid demanding, fast-changing hiring targets.
* Collaboration Across Boundaries: Works fluidly with delivery leads, technical architects, vendors, and cross-geography teams to keep pipelines moving.
* Resilience & Composure: Stays solutions-oriented under pressure from aggressive timelines, scarce talent pools, and shifting business priorities.
* Attention to Detail & Judgment: Applies sound judgment in candidate evaluation and skill classification, ensuring quality over volume in a noisy sourcing environment.
* Communication & Reporting: Communicates hiring status, risks, and recommendations clearly and confidently to senior leadership.

----------------------

title: Executive Assistant to CEO – Operations, HR & Executive Coordination
description:
**Job Title:** Executive Assistant to the CEO  
**Department:** CEO's Office / Operations  
**Reporting To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  
**Role Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Varanasi / Noida

1. Job Purpose

The Executive Assistant (EA) to the CEO will be responsible for providing comprehensive executive, administrative, operational, and coordination support to the CEO while ensuring the smooth functioning of day-to-day business operations.

The role involves coordinating with all departments, monitoring operational activities, facilitating HR functions, managing executive schedules, following up on management decisions, and ensuring timely execution of business priorities.

The EA will act as a central coordination point between the CEO, management team, employees, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure effective communication, accountability, and operational efficiency across the organization.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Executive Assistance to CEO

* Manage the CEO's daily calendar, appointments, meetings, and schedules.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, conferences, and business appointments.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and briefing documents.
* Record meeting minutes (MoM) and track action points.
* Follow up with respective department heads on tasks assigned by the CEO.
* Ensure timely completion of management decisions and commitments.
* Handle official emails, correspondence, and confidential communications.
* Screen and prioritize calls, emails, requests, and appointments.
* Coordinate the CEO's travel arrangements, hotel bookings, transportation, and itineraries.
* Maintain confidential records, documents, and important business information.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly updates for the CEO.
* Ensure the CEO is updated about important business matters, pending issues, and critical developments.

B. Business Operations & Management Coordination

* Coordinate and monitor the day-to-day operations of all departments.
* Ensure smooth communication and coordination between different teams.
* Follow up with department heads regarding daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
* Track operational activities, deliverables, deadlines, and pending tasks.
* Prepare operational MIS reports and management dashboards.
* Monitor execution of instructions and decisions given by the CEO.
* Identify operational gaps, delays, and coordination challenges and bring them to management's attention.
* Coordinate interdepartmental meetings and ensure proper follow-up.
* Assist in developing and implementing operational processes, SOPs, and systems.
* Maintain trackers for ongoing projects, assignments, and business activities.
* Ensure timely submission of departmental reports.
* Support management in improving productivity, efficiency, and accountability.

C. HR Operations & Coordination

* Coordinate with the HR department for recruitment and manpower requirements.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up on joining formalities and employee onboarding.
* Coordinate employee attendance, leave records, and related HR information.
* Monitor employee documentation and ensure records are maintained.
* Coordinate employee induction and orientation activities.
* Assist HR in organizing performance reviews and appraisal processes.
* Follow up on employee-related concerns and coordinate their resolution.
* Coordinate employee engagement activities, internal communication, and company events.
* Support HR in maintaining organizational charts and employee databases.
* Coordinate exit formalities, clearance processes, and employee handovers.
* Ensure timely communication between HR, management, and employees.
* Assist in implementing HR policies, procedures, and internal guidelines.

D. Administrative & Office Management

* Oversee general office administration and workplace coordination.
* Coordinate office infrastructure, maintenance, housekeeping, and facility requirements.
* Monitor office supplies, stationery, equipment, and inventory.
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and external agencies.
* Ensure proper maintenance of office records, documents, and agreements.
* Coordinate travel, accommodation, transportation, and hospitality arrangements.
* Monitor administrative expenses and support cost-control initiatives.
* Ensure the office operates smoothly and efficiently.
* Coordinate official events, meetings, conferences, and employee activities.

E. Management Reporting & MIS

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports for the CEO.
* Collect updates and performance information from all departments.
* Maintain management trackers for tasks, targets, projects, and pending activities.
* Prepare presentations, business reports, and performance summaries.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and departmental progress.
* Highlight delays, critical issues, and areas requiring management intervention.
* Ensure reports are accurate and submitted within defined timelines.
* Maintain records of important management decisions and follow-up actions.

F. Interdepartmental Coordination

Coordinate with all departments, including:

* Sales & Business Development
* Marketing & Digital Marketing
* Finance & Accounts
* Human Resources
* Operations & Production
* Procurement & Purchase
* Administration & Facilities
* Customer Support & Client Servicing
* IT & Technology
* Logistics & Supply Chain
* Projects & Business Development

Ensure proper communication, task allocation, follow-ups, and timely execution of activities across all departments.

G. Confidentiality & Corporate Governance

* Maintain strict confidentiality of CEO communications, business information, employee records, and company data.
* Handle sensitive business matters with professionalism and discretion.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of important decisions.
* Ensure adherence to company policies and internal procedures.
* Coordinate with relevant departments for statutory documentation and compliance-related follow-ups.
* Ensure sensitive matters are escalated to the CEO appropriately.

H. Special Projects & Strategic Support

* Assist the CEO with special assignments and business projects.
* Coordinate new business initiatives and organizational projects.
* Conduct basic research and prepare information for management decisions.
* Support business planning, process improvement, and implementation activities.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders, consultants, clients, and business partners.
* Monitor project timelines and ensure timely completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Take ownership of special tasks assigned directly by the CEO.

3. Key Deliverables / Expected Outcomes

* Smooth and efficient functioning of the CEO's office.
* Effective coordination across all departments.
* Timely execution of CEO instructions and management decisions.
* Accurate and timely MIS and operational reporting.
* Effective HR and administrative coordination.
* Proper tracking of departmental tasks and pending activities.
* Improved communication and accountability across the organization.
* Timely escalation and resolution of operational issues.
* Proper maintenance of confidential records and documentation.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent follow-up and coordination skills.
* Strong time management and prioritization.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities.
* Professional email writing and business communication.
* Good analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Knowledge of MIS reporting, documentation, and task management tools.
* Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* High level of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Ability to independently manage responsibilities and work closely with senior management.

5. Qualification & Experience

* Graduate or Postgraduate in Business Administration, Management, HR, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA in HR, Operations, or Business Management will be an added advantage.
* 3–7 years of experience in Executive Assistance, CEO Office Coordination, Business Operations, Administration, or Management Coordination.
* Experience working directly with senior management or a CEO is preferred.
* Experience in HR coordination and cross-functional operations will be an added advantage.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Timely execution and closure of CEO-assigned tasks.
* Effectiveness of interdepartmental coordination.
* Accuracy and timely submission of MIS reports.
* Efficiency in managing the CEO's calendar and meetings.
* Follow-up and closure rate of management action points.
* Timely completion of HR and administrative coordination activities.
* Reduction in operational delays due to coordination gaps.
* Quality of communication and reporting.
* Confidentiality and professionalism.
* Overall improvement in operational efficiency and management support.

7. Authority & Accountability

The Executive Assistant will be authorized to coordinate with all department heads and employees for information, updates, reports, and follow-ups on matters assigned by the CEO.

The EA will be accountable for tracking the progress of assigned responsibilities, highlighting delays, escalating critical issues, and ensuring timely communication to the CEO.

**Important:** This position is not limited to traditional secretarial or calendar-management responsibilities. It is a comprehensive CEO Office, Executive Assistance, HR Coordination, and Business Operations Coordination role requiring ownership, accountability, proactive follow-up, and strong management support.

8. Overall Role Expectation

The ideal candidate will function as the CEO's key support person and central coordination link across the organization, ensuring that the CEO's priorities are communicated, departmental responsibilities are tracked, operational matters are addressed, and management decisions are implemented effectively.

The person should be proactive, responsible, organized, trustworthy, and capable of managing multiple business functions while maintaining complete confidentiality and professionalism.

description:
JOB DETAILS
  
  
**Type of contract :** Consultant Contract
  
  
**Level :** Level 2 - Middle
  
  
**Hiring Unit :** Communication and Information Sector (CI)
  
  
**Duty Station :** New Delhi
  
  
**Work location :** On site
  
  
**Duration of contract :** 6 months
  
  
**Hiring open to :** External candidates
  
  
**Application deadline (Midnight UTC+5 Time) :** 08/12/2026
  
  
**UNESCO Core Values:** Commitment to the Organization, Integrity, Respect for Diversity, Professionalism
  
  
OVERVIEW
  
  
Under the overall authority of the Director of the UNESCO Regional Office in New Delhi and the direct supervision of the Regional Adviser for Communication and Information, the consultant will support project launch, the inception phase and initial implementation until the national project team is in place.
  
  
UNESCO is implementing the European Union-funded project “Strengthening Media Safety, Digital Rights and Inclusive Policy Engagement in India”. The 36-month action strengthens digital rights and inclusive digital policy engagement through research, dialogue and capacity-building, while enhancing journalist safety, legal protection and enabling judicial environments. Implementation combines UNESCO technical guidance and convening with grants and other arrangements involving qualified local organizations.
  
  
The six-month assignment will establish the technical and operational foundations for delivery across the six project outputs and ensure a documented transition to the national project team. The international consultant will initiate and coordinate project implementation activities until the national project team is recruited and operational.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
ASSIGNMENTS
  
  
1.a. Project inception and planning
  
  
Prepare the consultancy workplan and a first-year implementation plan, with responsibilities, milestones and dependencies. Coordinate stakeholder consultations and consolidate needs-assessment, gender-analysis and safety-mapping findings. Support refinement of the theory of change, results framework, baselines, targets and monitoring and evaluation framework. Prepare the inception report and revised project documentation for UNESCO review. The proposal requires submission to the donor within 30 days after completion of the three-month inception phase; dates must be aligned with the actual project calendar.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
1.b. Technical preparation across project outputs
  
  
Prepare activity concepts, technical briefs and terms of reference for research on digital rights and platform governance (Output 1.1); policy dialogues, exchanges and fellowships (Output 1.2); and capacity-building on platform governance and accountability (Output 1.3). Prepare technical specifications for judicial and legal capacity-building (Output 2.1), legal assistance and safety/protection activities (Output 2.2), and legal-network learning and case-documentation activities (Output 2.3). Prioritize early activities through the approved workplan.
  
  
1.c. Calls for proposals and partner mobilization
  
  
Preparation of procurement plan for the project. Draft priority calls for proposals, application guidance, technical assessment criteria and reporting templates. Support applicant briefings, assessment documentation and due diligence with authorized colleagues and panels. Prepare partner workplans, deliverable schedules and onboarding materials covering reporting, inclusion, safeguarding and confidentiality. Maintain an application and agreement tracker. Award decisions remain with authorized bodies.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
1.d. Stakeholder coordination and initial delivery
  
  
Map relevant public authorities, regulators, judicial and academic institutions, media organizations, civil society and specialist providers. Prepare an engagement plan, briefing notes, agendas and meeting records. Coordinate agreed early consultations and technical activities, document follow-up and timely escalate matters requiring senior decisions.
  
  
1.e. Monitoring, risk management and reporting
  
  
Establish results, activity and partner-monitoring tools, with gender-sensitive indicators and appropriately disaggregated data. Maintain a risk register and support activity-specific safety and sensitivity assessments. Prepare draft confidentiality and information-handling arrangements with relevant specialists. Prepare monthly updates and inputs to Steering Committee and donor reporting. Submit sensitive communications for clearance and keep confidential protection activities separate from public visibility.
  
  
1.f. Transition and handover
  
  
Brief the incoming national team and transfer project tools and records. Prepare a final report and handover package covering activities, partners, grants, risks, decisions, outstanding commitments and a prioritized forward implementation plan.
  
  
CONTRACT DURATION
  
  
Six months
  
  
Long Description
  
  
DELIVERABLES
  
  
Provide interim day-to-day project management under the supervisor until the national project team is recruited and operational, coordinating delivery, partners, grants, expenditure with administrative colleagues, results, risks and reporting. Follow the approved timetable; do not assume assessments, consultations or tools are complete. Agree the workplan within ten working days. Payment requires UNESCO approval of these deliverables:
  
  
**2.a. End of Month 1:** Draft inception package
  
  
Establish coordination and a Year 1 plan covering activities, responsibilities, timelines, expenditure and dependencies. Review documents, consult stakeholders and consolidate needs, gender and safety-mapping findings. Draft the inception report and refinements to the theory of change, results framework, baselines, targets and M&E framework. Prepare priority calls, guidance, assessment criteria and reporting templates; support selection and due diligence under the approved schedule. Establish a stakeholder map, engagement plan, application/agreement tracker and risk register. Prepare priority concepts, briefs, terms of reference or specifications.
  
  
**2.b. End of Month 2:** Final inception package and progress
  
  
Finalize the inception report and revised documents incorporating UNESCO's comments by the agreed internal deadline, allowing clearance and donor submission within 30 days after the three-month inception phase. Submit technical documents to the Regional Advisor in Delhi; update plans and trackers. Initiate priority activities; advance calls, partner selection and implementation arrangements. Report activity/grant progress, planned/actual expenditure available, and required decisions/actions.
  
  
**2.c. End of Month 3:** Implementation and partner mobilization
  
  
Report progress on sequenced research, policy, capacity-building and legal/safety-support activities. Support assessment, due diligence, agreements, partner workplans and deliverable schedules. Onboard partners on reporting, inclusion, safeguarding and confidentiality. Draft information-handling arrangements with specialists; support safety/sensitivity assessments and maintain consultation records. Obtain clearance for sensitive communications; separate confidential protection work from public visibility. Update the milestones, grants, results, expenditure and risks dashboard. Prepare scheduled quarterly Steering Committee documents and address donor inception comments.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**2.d. End of Month 4:** Delivery review
  
  
Review milestones, deliverables and evidence within the consultant’s remit; coordinate specialist reviews. Follow up delays, quality issues and constraints; escalate decisions. Submit a management report, updated dashboard, corrective actions and sequencing/expenditure forecast adjustments. Follow up missing baseline/monitoring information, maintain gender-sensitive indicators and disaggregated data, update risks and safety assessments, and apply inclusion, confidentiality and safeguarding measures.
  
  
**2.e. End of Month 5:** Transition
  
  
Maintain coordination and partner follow-up. Submit a dashboard and handover plan covering responsibilities, activities, commitments, deadlines, expenditure and unresolved issues. Brief incoming personnel or UNESCO focal points; transfer agreed duties, continue untransferred functions and document completed/outstanding transfers.
  
  
**2.f. End of Month 6:** Final report and handover

Document handover to the national team or UNESCO focal points of project, technical and stakeholder records, trackers, monitoring tools, risk register, decisions and commitments, with a prioritized three-month plan and outstanding follow-up.
